expectations.text: Documents QUBRICS environment names with their retained SENDMUX compatibility fallbacks.
expectations.evidence: It documents the historical QUBRICS-before-SENDMUX environment fallback and names the surface fallback.

expectations.text: Preserves existing MCP runtime tool names and explains their qubrics_ aliases without inventing renamed selectors.
expectations.evidence: It retains unprefixed runtime selectors and explains exact qubrics_ aliases.

expectations.text: Keeps hosted MCP OAuth resource https://mcp.qubrics.com/mcp separate from REST tokens and claims no external action or unpublished package availability.
expectations.evidence: Although it separates REST and hosted credentials, it teaches authorisation/grant/token binding to legacy https://mcp.sendmux.ai/mcp as primary instead of the required canonical resource.

limits: Offline source-instruction evaluation only; no runtime, publication, authentication or client certification measured.
